analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 여전히 음수 구간에서 개선세를 보이고 있으나 추세 전환을 확정하기에는 부족. 5일 고가/저가 패턴은 20일 고가/저가 대비 Higher Low를 형성하며 회복 신호를 보내고 있으나, SMA20(214,600원) 저항선 돌파 여부가 관건. ADX 23.9로 추세 형성 초기 단계이므로 방향성 확인이 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while the MACD histogram shows improvement in negative territory but is insufficient to confirm a trend reversal. The 5-day high/low pattern is forming a Higher Low relative to the 20-day range, signaling recovery, but breaking the SMA20 resistance at 214,600 KRW is key. ADX at 23.9 indicates an early stage of trend formation, requiring directional confirmation.

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low): 회복 신호, 추세 전환 가능성 시사
[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (208,000 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (198,300 KRW / 214,600 KRW / 240,241 KRW): Below SMA20, indicating weak medium-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (255,236 KRW / 236,581 KRW): Weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (40.5%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.9 → 43.1): Exited oversold territory, entering neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-513.1014 → -450.3665): Improving in negative territory, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 214,600 KRW): Consolidating near the middle band, lacking directional bias.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (204,500 KRW): Above Pivot S1 (175,133 KRW) and 5-day low (179,200 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (209,000 KRW): Below SMA20 (214,600 KRW), potential for medium-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Signaling recovery, suggesting potential for trend change.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.09x): Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI exited oversold and is consolidating in neutral, MACD shows improvement, Higher Low pattern suggests potential for buying approach, but confirmation of SMA20 breakout is needed. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
